scopes.ack: Full actual public patch ACK through typed receipt decoding, with one symmetric observation wrapper reading existing native-writer metrics.
scopes.native: Existing native queue, Connection::Query (including parse/bind/execute), copy, completion and port spans overlap public wall; not exclusive operator times.
scopes.verification: Independent typed/history/presence oracle calls follow each ACK and are separately timed.
scopes.operator: No EXPLAIN execution in this first screen. Exact operator attribution is a separately granted follow-up if this baseline identifies a need.
scopes.lifecycle: Fresh setup, populated open, drained revalidation, close and reopened checks are separate observations.
